location: England, Cumbria, Old Penrith Roman Fort
description: An inscriptions recovered from the Roman fort of Voreda (Old Penrith) that references the restoration of a temple to Jupiter Optimus Maximus of Doliche (Jupiter Dolichenus). The exact find spot of the inscription is unknown, and the location of the referenced temple is likewise unknown. Presumably it was in the vicinity of the fort. Assuming the temple was at least co-terminus with the fort places it in a late 1st CE - 300 CE date range. Archaeological investigation would be needed to narrow that further down.
bibliography: “RIB 916. Altar Dedicated to Jupiter Optimus Maximus of Doliche | Roman Inscriptions of Britain.” Inscription. Accessed April 7, 2026. https://romaninscriptionsofbritain.org/inscriptions/916.
